newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese police seize cocaine hidden in CDs.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese police seize cocaine hidden in CDs.

text.p: Portuguese police have confiscated about 10 kg (22 pounds) of cocaine stashed inside the packaging of about 1,000 imported compact discs and arrested two French nationals, a spokesman said on Monday.
"This is the first time we have found cocaine brought into the country inside CDs," Jose Ferreira Leite told reporters.
The suspects were arrested in the northern city of Oporto last week.
The cocaine, with a street value of hundreds of thousands of dollars, came from Panama, the spokesman said. The ultimate destination of the drugs was not known.
In July Portuguese police confiscated almost 40 kg (88 pounds) of cocaine smuggled into the country in machinery imported from South America.
International drug gangs run cocaine, heroin and cannabis into Portugal by land and sea. Some is consumed domestically and the rest exported to Europe, mainly the Netherlands and Spain.
